purpose: Quantify association between supplied corpus labels and recurring URL hostnames without using title text.

cleaning.title_normalization: Lowercase; remove URLs; retain ASCII letters and spaces; collapse whitespace.
cleaning.same_label_duplicates: Keep the first row for each normalized-title and label pair.
cleaning.cross_label_conflicts: Remove every retained row whose normalized title occurs under both labels.

hostname_parsing.wayback_urls: Recover the archived target URL before hostname parsing when a standard Wayback URL is present.
hostname_parsing.normalization: Lowercase, remove a single common presentation prefix (www, amp, m, or mobile), and strip a trailing dot.

diagnostic.predictor: Normalized hostname only; no title features.
diagnostic.cross_validation: Five-fold stratified out-of-fold prediction with shuffle=true and seed=42.
diagnostic.training_fold_rule: Map each hostname to its majority corpus label in the training folds.

interpretation_limits: This is an in-corpus association diagnostic, not an independent external test.
The folds are not source-disjoint because recurring hostnames may occur in training and held-out folds.
The result does not establish a causal publisher effect.
The supplied minimal CSV files do not reconstruct the complete original collection or fact-checking process.
